'''Dermian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]<ref name="DTS" />

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Ilum]], Major Dermian was based in the [[Imperial base camp]] under Colonel [[Baramak]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. When a shipment of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|crystals]] was lost, Major Dermian asked an Imperial ally to recover it.

==Behind the scenes==
Major Dermian first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].

It is only accessible to Imperial players in the game on Ilum.
